integrity: The Choi inequalities and asymptotic rates are proved analytically. Independent numerical reconstruction and high-precision root tests serve only as consistency checks. Independent expert review and literature-wide priority certification have not been performed.
limitations: Fixed two-parameter affine single-qubit semigroup; full-rank stationary state in the main theorem; no physical completely-positive divisibility of non-GKSL generators, experimental implementation, or arbitrary qubit-channel universality. The near-critical limit excludes simultaneous u to zero.
title: Sharp complete-positivity and entanglement-breaking arrival times in affine qubit semigroups
